Full Weekend

Weekend Schedule

It's been 20 years, and it's time to come home! Join the Olive Branch High School Class of 2006 for an unforgettable reunion weekend filled with laughter, memories, and celebration — whether you're reconnecting with lifelong friends, introducing your family to classmates, or dancing the night away.

Once a Conquistador, Always a Conquistador  💙💛

01
🤝
Meet & Greet

Friday · Nov 13 · 7:00 PM

Kick-Off Night

Huey's — Olive Branch

Kick off reunion weekend with a relaxed evening at Huey's. Catch up with classmates, enjoy great food and drinks, and reconnect before the weekend's main events. The perfect way to break the ice and start making new memories.

02
👪
Family Day

Saturday · Nov 14 · 10:00 AM – 1:00 PM

Back Where It Began

Olive Branch High School

Bring the entire family back to where it all began! Enjoy giant yard games, bounce houses, grilled hamburgers, hot dogs, chicken & more, and time to tour our alma mater. Celebrating not only the friendships we built in high school, but the families we've built over the past 20 years.

03
🥂
Gala Evening

Saturday · Nov 14 · 7:00 PM

A Night to Remember

Hilton Garden Inn — Olive Branch

Dress to impress for an elegant evening of great food, music, and dancing. Includes dinner, live DJ & dancing, photo booth, cocktail tickets (based on ticket purchase), and special moments celebrating the Class of 2006. Whether you've stayed in touch or this is your first reunion — this is your night.
